crossRefs.note: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed…
“Yahweh’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove…

translations.web: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:
translations.bsb: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who has knowledge from the Most High, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:
translations.kjv: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
translations.asv: He saith, who heareth the words of God, And knoweth the knowledge of the Most High, Who seeth the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:
